content.short: Belo is an Argentine digital wallet for holding local currency, crypto and stablecoins with a spending card.
content.description: Belo, founded in 2021 in Buenos Aires, is a Latin American digital wallet used by more than three million people to hold local currencies, crypto and dollar stablecoins in one app. Users can buy, hold, send and receive assets such as Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDC, convert to digital dollars to protect savings from inflation, and spend their balance through a linked card. Belo runs on stablecoin rails for low-cost transfers, foreign exchange and everyday payments. It raised a 14 million dollar Series A led by Tether to expand stablecoin payments across the region.
